annotations.title: Check an x402 payment before paying

description: Decide whether a specific x402 payment should go through: returns allow true/false with reasons. Checks the endpoint's trust verdict, that the amount is within your cap and not above the monitored price, and that the payTo wallet matches the one we've observed (catches swapped or hijacked wallets). Optionally (minOrganicShare) it also requires that enough of the seller's volume comes from independent buyers. Intended for right before a payment, with the amount, payTo, and network from the endpoint's 402 quote; allow is true only when every rule passes. Use check_endpoint instead if you only want an endpoint's grade without a quote in hand. Read-only and free; it doesn't make or block the payment itself. When allow is false, the reasons list explains why. API docs: https://github.com/Book0fEli/lumiere-paycheck/blob/main/docs/api.md

allowCaution.description: false = deny endpoints with a caution verdict too, not just avoid (default true)

amount.description: Amount about to be paid, atomic units (USDC has 6 decimals: 10000 = $0.01)

hasAccess.description: true if you have your own account, API key or sign-in with this seller. For endpoints that need the seller's sign-in on top of x402, allowCaution/requireVerified then don't block (we couldn't confirm delivery only because we can't sign in).

maxAmount.description: Your hard cap for this payment in atomic units (USDC: 1000000 = $1). Payments above it are denied.

minOrganicShare.description: Optional, 0-1: deny sellers where less than this share of 30-day volume comes from independent buyers (e.g. 0.5). Not applied to sellers whose buyers haven't been reviewed yet.

network.description: Network from the quote, e.g. eip155:8453

payTo.description: Wallet address from the endpoint's 402 quote

requireVerified.description: true = only allow endpoints that delivered on a real test payment (default false)

url.description: Full URL of the x402 endpoint you are about to pay, including path

name: check_payment

afterPaying.description: How to report the outcome after paying (free, verified on-chain)

authRequired.description: true: the seller needs its own sign-in on top of x402; send hasAccess: true if you have it

buyerReports.description: What real buyers reported after paying. Never changes the grade; confirmations move the endpoint up our paid-test queue.

confirmed.description: Buyers (customers or wallets) who reported a usable response in 7 days

ourTestQueued.description: Our own paid test is queued for this endpoint

problems.description: Buyers who reported a problem in 7 days

buyers.description: Who is really behind the seller's buyers. Never changes the grade.

buyerWallets30d.description: Buyer wallets that paid the seller in 30 days

estimated.description: true when counted from a sample of buyers

flags.description: coordinated_wallets, self_funded, concentrated_buyers, shared_operator, estimated, partial_lookup

independentBuyers30d.description: Independent buyers behind the seller's buyer wallets in 30 days (wallets funded from one source count as one)

organicShare.description: 0-1: share of 30-day volume from independent buyers

reviewed.description: false until the seller's buyers have been reviewed (the biggest sellers are reviewed daily)

declaredPayTo.description: Payout wallets the seller declared itself

forTeams.description: Short note about team plans (per-agent keys, spend limits, audit trail)

listing.description: Present only when the latest paid response differs from the listing's example or schema. The data is delivered.

capped.description: true: the data is reshaped vs the listing (nested, list vs item), grade capped at B; false: a minor gap, warning only

matchesExample.description: false: the paid response differs from the seller's own example

warning.description: How the real response differs, and where to read the fields

monitored.description: Whether the endpoint is in the monitored catalog

observed.description: The latest payment quote our monitor saw

reasons.description: Why it was allowed or denied

reviewable.description: Denied only for reasons a person may approve

values.description: Automatic value checks on the latest paid response
